contexts.text: The sordidly avaricious seem to themselves to pass their time in cells, where their money is... HH 488:4.
The ecclesiastics hid (the treasures) in its cells and subterranean vaults...
Like an adulterer who hides a harlot below in a cell... TCR 590.
The avaricious seem to themselves to be shut up in subterranean cells...
